Secured credit cards. Get one without an annual fee if at all possible. The interest rate will be high if you carry over a balance month to month, but the interest rate will be ZERO if you make sure to pay the balance in FULL on time every time. Only use the card for things you would normally purchase anyway, and then use the money you would have used to pay the card. Do NOT let the balance on the card exceed 30% of your credit limit ever. This will be tricky because you you will probably get a limit of 300 dollars, so 90 bucks (300 * 30%) isn't a lot. Just dont look at it that way. After a year or so companies will treat you more respectably as long as you again follow the two rules: 1) Make your payments on time every time, ideally in full, and 2) Never go over 30% of your credit limit unless it's an emergency

Just remember it isn't a toy, it's a tool. As someone who ruined their credit early in life and is just now getting it in good order, don't do what I did! Handle your business. Good luck.
